$comment: Built-in migration rules: legacy file -> registered location. Deliberately minimal: only mappings the ecosystem documents explicitly. Each product owner supplies the rest as rules; anything unmatched is reported as unplaced, never guessed (XENO LOCAL HOME - SPEC.md section 10.6). A 'copy' rule names kind+area+segments; a 'secret' rule names area+name and needs a secret sink. '{file}' stands for the matched file name; only the last path segment of 'match' may contain '*'.

rules.source: xeno-primitives/ADOPTION.md, xeno-shell row (~/.xeno/shell/state.json -> apps/shell); window state is kind state (LOCAL HOME spec section 5)
